texts.facts_text: The Applicant apprehending his arrest in with the Investigation of Crime No.708 of 2021 of Sardar Police Station, Solapur under Section 188, 272, 273 and Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the The Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 is seeking anticipatory bail. The prosecution case is that on a prior raid was conducted on the Accused No.1 and from his possession Tobacco Pouches, which are banned were recovered. Insofar present Applicant is concerned his house was shown by the No.1 and from the house of the present Applicant in a search, prohibited articles worth Rs.17,800/- were recovered.
texts.arguments_petitioner: The learned counsel for the Applicant pointed out that the offence cannot fall under Section 328 of Indian Penal Code as there is no allegation that the Applicant has administered any unwholesome or stupefying substance to any person, with an intention to commit an offence. It is submitted that the Applicant is ready and willing to co-operate with the Investigating Agency and there is no recovery which is to be made from the present Applicant.
texts.arguments_respondent: The learned Additional Public Prosecutor on instructions of the Investigating Officer states that the investigation is in final stage and investigation is to be carried out to find out the source of the prohibited articles which were found in possession of the Applicant.
texts.reasoning_text: Considering the fact that the accused No.1 has already been released on Regular Bail and looking to the quantity involved which is allegedly recovered from the house of the Applicant and there is no further recovery to be made.
texts.decision_text: In the result, the following order is passed. (i) In the event of his arrest in connection with investigation of Crime No.708 of 2021 registered with Sardar Bazar Police Station, the applicant shall be released on bail on executing a P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount. (ii) The Applicant shall attend the Investigating Officer on every Monday between 11.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and as and when required by the Investigating Officer. (iii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence/witnesses. (iv) In the event of breach of any of the conditions liberty to the prosecution to apply for modification. (v) The Criminal Application is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

key_facts_bullets: The Applicant apprehends arrest in connection with Investigation of Crime No.708 of 2021 at Sardar Police Station, Solapur.
Prohibited articles worth Rs.17,800/- were recovered from the Applicant's house during a search.
issues_bullets: Whether the offence falls under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code.
Cooperation of the Applicant with the Investigating Agency.
holdings_bullets: The offence does not fall under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code.
The Applicant is ready to cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
